# Three Generation Models

*Notes*

-   Set up folders for output prior to running (e.g. `bmi_ukb_pgs`)
-   Match FIDs in phenotype file to pedigree
-   All respondents in pheno file must also be in covariate/pc file
-   For uniparental, should remove `--bpg` flag

```{bash Setup}
## Destination folder for results with each PGS
mkdir adhd_pgs afb_repo_pgs afb_ukb_pgs bmi_ukb_pgs cpd_cur_ukb_pgs cpd_liu_pgs cpd_prev_ukb_pgs ea4_pgs
mkdir hgt_ukb_pgs neb_ukb_pgs neb_wom_repo_pgs smkfrq_cur_ukb_pgs dep_howard_pgs evrsmk_ukb_pgs

## Outcome Pheno File Order
## FID|IID|HGT|EA|COG|AFB|NEB|CPD.Max|CPD.Cur|CESD|BMI|DBP|SBP|BG.Fast|BG.All|HDL|LDL|NonHDL|FEV1
```

<!--- Test: Uniparental PGI Regressions for BMI --->
```{bash Test Case: 1 Pheno/1 PGI}
conda activate SNIPar_GP2_py38

## Modify directories as needed for uniparental
REG_OUT=~/sniparV2_analysis/sniparV2_unipar_reg/1pg_set
OUT_PHENO_TAB=~/sniparV2_analysis/sniparV2_unipar_phenos/fin_phenos2.txt
OUT_PHENO=BMI
PGS_PHENO=bmi_ukb
COVAR_TAB=~/sniparV2_analysis/sniparV2_unipar_phenos/fin_pcs2.txt
SPARSE_DAT=~/fhs_dat/snipar_phased_output/sparse_pairs

pgs.py \
  ${REG_OUT}/${PGS_PHENO}_pgs/${OUT_PHENO} \
  --phenofile ${OUT_PHENO_TAB} \
  --pgs ~/sniparV2_analysis/sniparV2_unipar_pgs/1pg_set/${PGS_PHENO}_ldpred2.pgs.txt \
  --covar ${COVAR_TAB} \
  --gen_models 3 \
  --phen_index 9 \
  --scale_pgs \
  --scale_phen \
  --sparse_thres 0.125 \
  --ibdrel_path ${SPARSE_DAT}
```

<!--- Final: Multi-Pheno/Multi-PGI --->
```{bash Final: Multi-Pheno/PGI}
conda activate SNIPar_GP2_py38

#===========================================================#
#============[ DEFINE MODEL COMPONENTS ]====================#
#===========================================================#
## Constant variables in loop
## Change REG_OUT for gparsum vs. separated models
REG_OUT=~/sniparV2_analysis/sniparV2_unipar_reg/1pg_set
OUT_PHENO_TAB=~/sniparV2_analysis/sniparV2_unipar_phenos/fin_phenos2.txt
COVAR_TAB=~/sniparV2_analysis/sniparV2_unipar_phenos/fin_pcs2.txt
SPARSE_DAT=~/fhs_dat/snipar_phased_output/sparse_pairs

## Index from 0 to (nvars - 1); length = nvars
## Complete vector: ${PGS_PHENO_VEC[*]:0:nvars} -> 0:14
PGS_PHENO_VEC=(adhd afb_repo afb_ukb bmi_ukb cpd_cur_ukb cpd_liu cpd_prev_ukb dep_howard ea4 
                evrsmk_ukb hgt_ukb neb_ukb neb_wom_repo smkfrq_cur_ukb)
                
## Order of phenotypes should match those in phenotype table, with HGT first
## Complete vector - ${OUT_PHENO_VEC[*]:0:17}
OUT_PHENO_VEC=(HGT EA COG AFB NEB CPD.Max CPD.Cur CESD BMI DBP SBP BG.Fast BG.All HDL LDL NonHDL FEV1)

#===========================================================#
#============[ RUN MODELS ]=================================#
#===========================================================#
## HGT: Run with PHEN_NUM=1 and --sparse_thres 0.05 and ${OUT_PHENO_VEC[*]:0:1}
## Other phenos: Run with PHEN_NUM=2 and --sparse_thres 0.05 and ${OUT_PHENO_VEC[*]:1:16}
## NOTE: If using other subset, should set PHEN_NUM to (1 + min index) in OUT_PHENO_VEC
GREEN='\033[0;32m' BLUE='\033[0;34m' NOCOLOR='\033[0m'
for PGS_PHENO in ${PGS_PHENO_VEC[*]:0:14}; do \
    PHEN_NUM=2; \
    echo -e "\n${GREEN}Current PGS: ${PGS_PHENO} ${NOCOLOR}"; \
    for OUT_PHENO in ${OUT_PHENO_VEC[*]:1:16}; do \
        echo -e "\n${BLUE}---> Phenotype Index ${PHEN_NUM}: ${OUT_PHENO}${NOCOLOR}"; \
        pgs.py \
            ${REG_OUT}/${PGS_PHENO}_pgs/${OUT_PHENO} \
            --phenofile ${OUT_PHENO_TAB} \
            --pgs ~/sniparV2_analysis/sniparV2_unipar_pgs/1pg_set/${PGS_PHENO}_ldpred2.pgs.txt \
            --covar ${COVAR_TAB} \
            --gen_models 1-3 \
            --phen_index ${PHEN_NUM} \
            --scale_pgs \
            --scale_phen \
            --sparse_thres 0.05 \
            --ibdrel_path ${SPARSE_DAT} \
            --threads 30; \
        ((PHEN_NUM++)); \
    done; \
done
```
